ei.title: How a Growing Closedness of Mind Endangers Us with Age
ei.subject: 6월_2023 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: How a Growing Closedness of Mind Endangers Us with Age

fullPassage: In adolescence many of us had the experience of falling under the sway of a great book or writer. We became entranced by the novel ideas in the book, and because we were so open to influence, these early encounters with exciting ideas sank deeply into our minds and became part of our own thought processes, affecting us decades after we absorbed them. Such influences enriched our mental landscape, and in fact our intelligence depends on the ability to absorb the lessons and ideas of those who are older and wiser. Just as the body tightens with age, however, so does the mind. And just as our sense of weakness and vulnerability motivated the desire to learn, so does our creeping sense of superiority slowly close us off to new ideas and influences. Some may advocate that we all become more skeptical in the modern world, but in fact a far greater danger comes from the increasing closing of the mind that burdens us as individuals as we get older, and seems to be burdening our culture in general.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① affected → affecting: '우리에게 영향을 주며'라는 능동의 분사구문이므로 현재분사 affecting이 맞음
det.analysis:
✅ ① affected — 원문은 affecting이에요. '...became part of our own thought processes, __________ us decades after'에서 생각들이 우리에게 '영향을 주는' 능동 관계라 현재분사 affecting이 맞아요. affected(과거분사)는 수동이라 틀려요. ←정답

❌ ② depends — 'our intelligence depends on(지성은 ~에 달려 있다)'. 단수주어 intelligence에 맞는 현재동사라 맞아요.

❌ ③ to absorb — 'the ability to absorb(흡수하는 능력)'. 명사를 꾸미는 to부정사라 맞아요.

❌ ④ burdens — 'that burdens us(우리를 짓누르는)'. 단수 선행사에 맞는 동사라 맞아요.
det.tip: 생각이 우리에게 '영향을 주는' 능동 → 현재분사 affecting

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ so the mind does → so does the mind: 'so + 동사 + 주어' 도치가 맞음
det.analysis:
❌ ① entranced — 'We became entranced(매료되었다)'. become의 보어인 과거분사라 맞아요.

❌ ② absorbed — 'after we absorbed them(그것들을 흡수한 뒤)'. 과거동사라 맞아요.

✅ ③ so the mind does — 원문은 so does the mind예요. '몸이 굳듯 마음도 그러하다'라는 뜻으로 'so' 뒤에는 '동사+주어' 어순의 도치가 와야 하므로 so does the mind가 맞아요. so the mind does는 어순이 틀려요. ←정답

❌ ④ comes — 'a far greater danger comes from(더 큰 위험이 ~에서 온다)'. 단수주어 danger에 맞아 맞아요.
det.tip: so + 동사 + 주어 (도치) → so does the mind

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ to burdening → to be burdening: 'seems to be -ing' 진행형 to부정사가 맞음

❌ ③ superiority(우월감): '서서히 커지는 우월감' — 맞아요.

det.korean: ② inferiority → superiority: 마음을 닫게 하는 것은 '우월감(superiority)'이므로 '열등감(inferiority)'은 부적절
det.analysis:
❌ ① entranced(매료된): 새 생각에 매료되었다 — 맞아요.

questions.passage: In adolescence many of us had the experience of falling under the sway of a great book or writer. We became entranced by the novel ideas in the book, and because we were so open to influence, these early encounters with exciting ideas sank deeply into our minds and became part of our own thought processes, affecting us decades after we absorbed them. Such influences enriched our mental landscape, and in fact our intelligence depends on the ability to absorb the lessons and ideas of those who are older and wiser. Just as the body tightens with age, however, so does the mind. And just as our sense of weakness and vulnerability motivated the desire to learn, so does our creeping sense of superiority slowly close us off to new ideas and influences. Some may advocate that we all become more skeptical in the modern world, but in fact a far greater danger comes from the increasing closing of the mind that burdens us as individuals as we get older, and seems to be burdening our culture in general.

❌ ① 'In adolescence many of us had the experience of falling under the sway of a great book or writer'와 일치해요.
